module: Flowgraph node "Point on Decalroad" (repeat_instant). Tests whether a point (vec3) is on a DecalRoad (roadId) via roadObj:containsPoint, forcing z to the altitude of the road's first node. Outputs: inside / outside (flow), onRoad (bool), closestIdx (index of the closest control point, -1 if off the road), maxIdx (number of points - 1).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes point to (0,0,0) and pz to 0.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the road cache and empties the outputs.

work.desc: Reloads the road if roadId changes, then computes closestIdx, onRoad, inside and outside.
